empty.title: No subscriptions yet
empty.hint: Add Netflix, Spotify or cloud storage — Saldo shows the month's planned payments and the monthly average cost.

totals.normalizedNote: A yearly price is divided by 12, not charged every month
totals.unknown: Without {count, plural, one {# amount} other {# amounts}}: amount unknown or no rate

verdict.label: Do you still need this subscription?
verdict.hint: A note just for you: it does not change any payments. Subscriptions answered “Not sure” are gathered under the “Not sure” filter.

done.review: {name}: marked “Not sure”. Find all of these under the “Not sure” filter
done.cancel: {name}: marked “Not needed”. Payments go on until you cancel the subscription on its card

verdict.doneCancelHere: {name}: marked “Not needed”. Payments go on until you press “Cancel subscription” on this page

defaults.title: Subscription defaults
defaults.hint: A new subscription starts from these settings. Existing subscriptions do not change: their own rules win.

form.name: Name
form.amount: How much you pay each time
form.amountHint: Amount not known yet? Leave it empty
form.firstOnHint: The next payments are counted from it
form.shortMonthRule: If the month has no such day

rules.last_day: Pay on the last day of the month
rules.next_month_first: Pay on the 1st of the next month

form.serviceEmpty: This service is not in the list
form.currencyHint: A currency change applies to future payments only
form.repeatSummary: {summary}, counted from the first payment date
form.shortMonthRuleHint: For example, you pay on the 31st, but February has 28 days

card.notFound: Subscription not found: it may have been removed

details.title: Details
details.shortMonth: If the month has no such day

price.title: Price
price.hint: A price change affects only the future plan. Past payments do not change.
price.sheetHint: The new price changes only the future plan; paid payments and operations stay as they are.
price.effectiveHint: Payments before this date and paid ones keep the old price

cancel.title: Cancellation
cancel.hint: Cancelling in Saldo does not cancel {name} itself. Mark the intent, the confirmed cancellation and the date access ends separately.
cancel.sheetHint: Saldo does not cancel the subscription in the service — do it in {name}. After cancelling, future payments leave the plan; the history stays.
cancel.accessHint: Usually the end of the paid period

pause.title: Pause {name}?
pause.hint: While paused, its payments are not part of the month's plan and are not planned.
pause.info: The payment history stays. Resume it from the subscription card.

archive.title: Remove {name} from tracking?
archive.hint: A subscription is not deleted: its payments are part of the history and totals. It is archived — it leaves the list and the plan.
archive.info: You can restore it any time from the «Archive» filter.
archive.cardHint: {name} leaves the list and the plan. The payment history stays.
archive.restoreHint: {name} is not part of the plan. Restore it to plan its payments again.
